name: How are molding and trim installation costs calculated?

mainEntity.name: How are molding and trim installation costs calculated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Total molding installation costs depend on linear footage, material choice, profile complexity, and the condition of your existing walls. Simple baseboard replacement in a single room costs significantly less than running multi-piece crown molding throughout an entire home. Additional factors influencing the final price include whether old trim must be removed and hauled away, wall irregularities requiring shimming or drywall prep, and whether caulking and final painting are included in the carpentry scope. Getting an on-site evaluation ensures an accurate quote.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs are calculated based on total linear footage, trim material, profile complexity, wall prep requirements, and whether painting and finishing are included in the scope.
